zh: 位置权重 i 从左到右递增。如果一个较大的值排在一个较小的值前面，交换两者会让总和增加“位置差 × 数值差”，所以最优排列中的数值必须非降。
数值非降之后，不同数值之间的先后顺序就完全确定了；只有相同数值之间可以互换而不改变总和。为了字典序最小，同值元素的下标应从小到大排列。
把原下标按（数值，下标）升序排序，依次输出“下标加 1”。数值可以为负，排序规则不变。
en: The position weight i increases from left to right. If a larger value sits before a smaller one, swapping them increases the sum by (position difference) × (value difference), so in an optimal permutation the values must be non-decreasing.

Once the values are non-decreasing, the relative order of different values is fully determined; only equal values can be swapped without changing the sum. For the lexicographically smallest answer, equal values should appear in increasing index order.
Sort the original indices by (value, index) in ascending order and print each index plus 1. Values can be negative; the ordering rule stays the same.

explanationEn:
## Approach

Sort the original indices by (data[i],i) in ascending order and output the one-based indices.

## Proof of correctness

If a larger value is in a smaller position and a smaller value in a larger position, swapping them increases the sum by the position difference times the value difference, so a maximum sum requires non-decreasing values. The relative order of groups with different values is therefore unique; swapping equal values does not change the gain, so arranging each group by increasing original index gives the lexicographically smallest permutation.

## Complexity

Time O(n log n), space O(n).
